expectation: Membrane/dendrite stain on dendritic cells and some macrophages: scattered single cells with branching processes, denser in lymphoid aggregates, stroma and beneath epithelium. Uncommon (a few % of cells); most cells negative.
observed: A: diffuse yellow haze over the tissue, speckle off the tissue, some bright puncta at the edges. B/C: haze plus elongated streaks and one ring-shaped cell in C. D: elongated bright cell bodies between nuclei. E1: many separate branching cells with a dendritic shape, clustered in one region. E2 HLADRA is mostly haze; E3 has some white overlap.
why: E1 shows many separate cells with the branching dendritic shape expected of CD11c+ DCs, standing out clearly over the background, despite haze at whole-tissue scale.
notes: The whole tissue is hazy, but at field scale CD11c marks distinct branching dendritic-like cells, clustered in one area. HLADRA is too hazy to confirm or rule out co-expression in row E.
